criteria.description: Go and generated web heartbeat-observation constants agree on kind 30315 without a heartbeat-specific frontend drift override.
Backend heartbeat serialization emits NIP-38 status kind 30315 with #domain=continuity, heartbeat schema/d/worker tags, and no legacy 30350 production tag.
The Go catalog projects only continuity-domain heartbeat-shaped 30315 events as heartbeat observations and leaves other 30315 status domains generic.
The web continuity route source subscribes to heartbeat observations using kind 30315 with #domain=continuity and never kind 30350, and ignores unrelated 30315 domains as heartbeats.
tests: continuity-nostr.test.ts: uses scoped filters for continuity status, definitions, heartbeat, and worker state events
continuity-nostr.test.ts: ignores shared kind 30315 statuses outside the continuity heartbeat domain

criteria.description: Architecture/control-plane/event-kind docs and PSTF evidence document 30315/#domain=continuity as the heartbeat contract.
